Methodology

Trust-Weighting Formula

EvidenceScore

TrustScore = 0.30×Audit + 0.20×Consistency + 0.20×Robustness + 0.15×Stability + 0.15×Power. Scale 0–100. Grades: A+ (≥90), A (≥80), B (≥70), C (≥60), D (≥50), F (<50).

Erosion Analysis

Thresholds 50–90

For each trust threshold T, significant MAs are split into Surviving (score ≥ T), Weakened (significant but score < T), and Excluded (non-significant or missing). Erosion rate = (excluded + weakened) / total significant.

Influence Score Formula

Citation + Guideline Relevance

Influence = 0.4×CitationPercentile + 0.1×GroupSizePercentile + 20 if WHO-matched + min(10×NICECount, 30). This combines academic impact with therapeutic importance and direct guideline exposure.

Risk Register Quadrants

2×2 Matrix

Red Flag: low trust + high influence. Hidden Gem: high trust + low influence. Safe: high trust + high influence. Low Stakes: low trust + low influence. Moderate: everything between these thresholds.

Data Sources

Cochrane + PubMed Cache

Meta-analyses come from Cochrane Reviews (6,229 MAs across 501 reviews). Trust scores come from the MetaAudit pipeline. Citation counts come from cached PubMed cited-by lookups. WHO Essential Medicines matches come from a curated local list, and NICE counts are read from the local NICE cache when available.

TrustGate: Trust-weighted meta-meta-analysis. Covering 6,229 Cochrane MAs. Generated 2026-04-03.
